role_definitions.medicare_patient_empirical_candidate: Potential direct Medicare patient coverage, reimbursement or access evidence; eligibility and estimates require human review.
role_definitions.medicare_descriptive_drug_use: Direct Medicare drug-use/expenditure description; clinical need and equity relevance must be established before primary access synthesis.
role_definitions.medicare_service_valuation_candidate: Potential direct Medicare service-valuation evidence; distinct from beneficiary or physician-gender effects.
role_definitions.valuation_input_directness_unresolved: Service-valuation component potentially relevant, but payer inputs or modeled-dollar interpretation require verification.
role_definitions.clinical_efficacy_safety_background: Clinical benefit, harm, or need context; not an original Medicare coverage, cost or access effect.
role_definitions.other_payer_empirical_background: Original costs or coverage-policy evidence in other or mixed payers; no separately verified Medicare effect.
role_definitions.physician_gender_context: Medicare physician-gender comparison; outside the primary patient/service synthesis.
role_definitions.general_or_qualitative_context: General clinical/social framework or non-Medicare qualitative mechanisms; outside direct Medicare empirical synthesis.
